metadata.description: AgentX for Cursor — production tracing for your own agent, and evaluation triage against a self-hosted AgentX engine

plugins.name: agentx
plugins.description: Get your agent's real runs into AgentX, then turn what they measure into a code fix. /instrument sets up a Python agent and proves it with traces it reads back; /eval-fix triages an evaluation against the source and re-runs it on the same dataset.
